title: 第1章
slug: 鍏堝氬悗鐖澶у彅鎴戞墠鎴愬勾
content_zh: 认错了人宽大而凌乱的床上，一娇小的身影睡在上面，削瘦而线条完美的背部暴露在外面，司绵趴睡在被子上，她迷迷糊糊的醒来，脸上还有宿醉后的红晕。她撑起身体，伸手揉了一下眼睛，几点了，她九点要上班的，不能再迟到了，不然她就工资会被扣光的。准备掀开被子起床换衣服，却不想，刚一动，身体就疼得直抽抽，她皱眉的睁开眼睛，低头就看见自己浑身赤|裸，肌肤上还布满了可疑的痕迹。顿时她清醒了，她记得昨晚她喝了一整瓶的红酒，然后她趁着酒意推开了一扇门，然后扑倒了她的上司。看这个情形，她是成功了，她瞪大了眼睛坐起来，扫视了一圈，房间里没人，他呢？不会提前跑了吧。腿疼得要死，大腿上还有残留的血迹，抓起被子覆盖住身体。就在她龇牙咧嘴喊疼的时候，旁边有人靠近，她快速的偏头，嘴角绽放了一朵灿烂的微笑，但是当看清楚那人的样子时，她的微笑僵住。这人是谁啊？怎么这么不眼熟啊？看见房间里有陌生人，她快速把自己裹起来，只露出一颗脑袋，戒备的看着站在床边的男子。“你谁啊，怎么会在这里？”眼前男子的装扮让司绵背后扬起一股不祥的预感。他有一张斯文而秀气的脸庞，睫毛修长，眼睛是单眼皮的，长得特有味道，头发微湿，显然刚才洗过澡。他身上穿了白衬衣和休闲裤，脚上踩着拖鞋，衬衣的袖子被挽上去了，露出手腕上那只低调却富有品位的手表。顾墨略微皱了一下眉头，低沉的回答，“我住在这里”司绵诧异的看着他，揪着被子，他住在这里？什么意思？“难道你是年修仁新聘请的司机？助理？保姆？”“我不知道你说什么”他新上任不久，各种应酬饭局不断，昨天视察了一些地方，晚上和那些人吃了饭，喝了些酒，不宜开车，就在附近找了一家酒店住下。洗完澡出来，酒劲去了一些，但是还是有些晕，有点后悔不该喝那么多。可能是进房的时候门没紧闭，门一下子就被撞开了，他还没反应过来，就被人抱住，酒香夹杂着淡淡的奶香映入鼻翼。顾墨有些醉，所以被她这么一扑，人没站稳，往后退了几步，两人一起倒在了床上。他推开她一点，看她迷迷糊糊的，小脸上红扑扑的，像是喝了不少酒，应该是走错房间了。刚打算把她送出房去，她就死死的拽住他的衣服，口里不停嘀嘀咕咕的说些什么东西，然后就开始抱着他的脖子开始啃。顾墨有些反感借酒装疯的人，连忙将她推开。哪只她的力气很大，跟牛皮糖一样，扯都扯不掉，再加上他现在也头重脚轻。纠缠当中，他和她都衣衫不整了，司绵撕开他的衣服，咬住他胸前的红豆，毫无技巧的咬的。疼痛让顾墨皱眉，却也让他的尾椎骨一麻，很舒服很痛快的感觉，他吐出带着酒味的呼吸。“再跟你说一遍，立刻起来”顾墨努力保持着最后一份清醒。他不屑趁人之危，更不想明天早上起来，有人哭着喊着说他是强|奸犯。司绵怎么可能起来，她今天来就是打算生米煮成熟饭的，所以她四肢缠着他，丝毫不放松，而且还拼命的吻他。动作生涩的可以。顾墨的气息浓重了一些。要是唤作是平时，顾墨一定会把她踢开的，但是今晚，不知道是被她身上的香味迷惑了，还是真的醉了。他一个翻身将她压在身下。“年修仁呢？”司绵见情形不对，连忙问。“谁是年修仁？”见他不知道年修仁是谁，司绵的心一度往下沉，歇斯底里的吼道，“你怎么可以随便闯进别人的房间，你知不知道我可以告你的，卑鄙无耻下流”“这间房是我开的，应该是你闯进我的房间吧”顾墨揉了揉胀痛的太阳穴，早知道她是个麻烦。昨晚因为灯光是原因没彻底看清楚她的样子，现在仔细一看，长得真幼齿，不会还没成年吧。一想到这个可能，顾墨的眉头就皱的更加的厉害了。要真是这样，传出去对他的影响不好，而且他的一世英名也就毁了。
content_en: I recognized the wrong person. On the large and messy bed, a petite figure was sleeping on it, with her thin and perfect back exposed. Si Mian was sleeping on the quilt. She woke up in a daze, with a hangover blush on her face. She propped herself up and rubbed her eyes. What time was it? She had to go to work at nine o'clock. She couldn't be late again, otherwise her salary would be deducted. She was about to lift the quilt and get up to change clothes, but she didn't expect that as soon as she moved, her body throbbed with pain. She frowned and opened her eyes. When she lowered her head, she saw that she was naked, and her skin was covered with suspicious marks. Suddenly she woke up, and she remembered that she drank a whole bottle of red wine last night, and then she pushed open a door while she was drunk, and then threw her boss down. Looking at this situation, she succeeded. She sat up with her eyes widened and glanced around. There was no one in the room. Where was him? You won't run away early. My legs hurt terribly, and there was still blood on my thighs. I grabbed the quilt and covered my body. Just when she bared her teeth and cried out in pain, someone came close to her. She quickly tilted her head, and a bright smile bloomed at the corner of her mouth, but when she saw the person's appearance clearly, her smile froze. Who is this person? Why does it look so unfamiliar? Seeing a stranger in the room, she quickly wrapped herself up, leaving only her head exposed, and looked warily at the man standing beside the bed. "Who are you, and why are you here?" The dress of the man in front of him made Si Mian feel an ominous feeling behind him. He has a gentle and delicate face, long eyelashes, eyes with single eyelids, a unique look, and slightly wet hair. He has obviously taken a shower just now. He was wearing a white shirt and casual pants, with slippers on his feet. The sleeves of his shirt were rolled up, revealing the low-key but tasteful watch on his wrist. Gu Mo frowned slightly and replied in a low voice, "I live here." Si Mian looked at him in surprise and grabbed the quilt. He lived here? What's the meaning? "Are you Nian Xiuren's newly hired driver? Assistant? Nanny?" "I don't know what you are talking about." Not long after he took office, he had various social dinners. Yesterday he inspected some places. He had dinner with those people in the evening and drank some wine. It was not suitable to drive, so he found a hotel nearby to stay. After I came out of the shower, I felt a little less drunk, but I was still a little dizzy and regretted that I shouldn't have drank so much. Maybe it was because the door wasn't closed tightly when he entered the room, but it was suddenly knocked open. Before he could react, he was hugged, and the aroma of wine mixed with the faint fragrance of milk hit his nostrils. Gu Mo was a little drunk, so he couldn't stand still when she pounced on him. He took a few steps back and the two of them fell on the bed together. He pushed her away a little and saw that she was dazed and her face was flushed. She seemed to have drunk a lot of wine and she must have gone to the wrong room. Just when he was about to send her out of the room, she grabbed his clothes tightly, kept mumbling something, and then started hugging his neck and started nibbling. Gu Mo was a little disgusted with people pretending to be crazy while drinking, and quickly pushed her away. She was so strong that she couldn't pull it off like a piece of candy. Plus, he was also top-heavy now. During the entanglement, both he and she were disheveled. Si Mian tore off his clothes and bit the red bean on his chest without any skill. The pain made Gu Mo frown, but it also made his tailbone numb. It felt very comfortable and pleasant, and he breathed out breath that smelled of alcohol. "I'll tell you again, get up immediately." Gu Mo tried hard to stay awake for the last time. He didn't want to take advantage of others' danger, and he didn't want to wake up tomorrow morning to someone crying and shouting that he was a rapist. How could Si Mian get up? She came here today with the intention of cooking the rice, so she wrapped her arms and legs around him without relaxing at all, and even kissed him desperately. It's okay if the movements are jerky. Gu Mo's breath became stronger. If it were normal times, Gu Mo would definitely kick her away, but tonight, I don't know if he was confused by the scent of her body, or if he was really drunk. He turned over and pinned her down. "Where is Nian Xiuren?" Si Mian asked quickly when he saw something was wrong. "Who is Nian Xiuren?" Seeing that he didn't know who Nian Xiuren was, Si Mian's heart sank for a moment and he shouted hysterically, "How can you just break into other people's rooms? Do you know I can sue you? It's despicable and despicable." "I opened this room. You should be the one who broke into my room." Gu Mo rubbed his painful temples, knowing she was a trouble. I didn't get a clear look at her last night because of the lighting, but now that I'm looking carefully, I can see that she looks really young, so she's not yet an adult. Gu Mo frowned even more when he thought of this possibility. If this is the case, it will have a bad influence on him and his reputation will be ruined.
novel_title: 先婚后爱,大叔,我才成年
